subject: Pipe Dream

body:

subject: I have dolls...
author: SUFFUR
body:
But they are worth money now, I have the original Darth Vader and Bubba Fet, you know the 12 inch, ones, i know they are that 'long' as i just have to pull down my pants and measure, and they are just that bit bigger that me main thinking cap. I even have the smaller ones, that you can compare too if you want Bootleg(not  so) giant 😉. Anyway i like collectables, have been a collectore for a long time, have all the original Star Wars comics and have a lot of Dark Horse Comics, Predator, Alien etc i also have the old Superman, Green Lantern, X-Men, Punisher etc. I even have Action Man, GI Joe and my old Lego sets. As well as my HotWheels cars by Match BOX and sorry for this, my dads Dinky toys like tanks and Jeeps. I don't mind Action Figures as Kevin Smith would say, but my dolls made me the snappy undresser that i am today, down to my blue non-take-off pants. Plus my Action Men dated Princess Lea in the day, way before Hand Sol(ow)o got to her and her insestuas brother and father.

Now Boot, when do you want to get down to some serious play, i'll even let you use my dolls to enact what you might want to say to me next, i have a Lurky Doll, and i'm sure you can borrow my sisters Rainbow Bright, or you might prefer my Buzz Light Years and go to infinity and beyond, i have two but i did not need the Woody doll. And when your done i'll push the belly of my Elmo, as your not worth wasting my breath in laughter. Till next time blog master. 😉,😉, nudge, nudge, say no more?!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?
